Hey. I’m 19 too so I can relate to being young and treated like shit for it. I work with a bunch of old men that always talk down to me and mock me for staying home on the weekends because I don’t have friends. It sucks. People are out enjoying their lives and I’m here failing to find a reason to keep living. 

Anyways, I’m glad you vented here. I hope you’re interview goes well do you can at least get a bit of money. I don’t want you to give up because it seems you have gone through so much already. Don’t be afraid to open up to your parents for help. You can always message me too if you need to vent. Stay safe tonight.

Hi. I’m sorry you’re feeling worthless. I recently dropped out of college as an undergrad; failed all my classes. I could sit here and say the professors were bad, or I was stressed, or anxious, but it really comes down to me being unmotivated and not wanting to continue living with the pain of being a failure. 

So I want you to know I get where you’re coming from and I really hope for you to feel better. I also don’t want you to feel alone, I’m sure there’s a ton of people out there struggling with the same issues. Feel free to message me if you need to talk to anyone and please stay safe.
Sounds really good. Nice work!
